title: The Weekly Challenge - 397
task1_desc: You are given an array of integers. Write a script to return the smallest absent positive integer such that it is strictly greater than the average of all elements in the given array.
task2_desc: You are given an array of integer. Write a script to sort the given array in ascending order based on the binary reflection of each element. If two different numbers have the same binary reflection, the smaller original number should appear first.
